units.source_text: 到了一条宫邸，但觉殿内毫无悲惨气象，出入人员众多，竟是另一世界。

en.t: They arrived at the Ichijo palace, but inside there was no sign of grief at all; many people were coming and going, and it seemed like another world entirely.
The carriage stopped in front of the gate.

units.source_text: 公主即将下车之时，似觉不是回返故邸，却是到了一个陌生地方，心中害怕，一时不肯下车。

en.t: Just as the princess was about to get out, she seemed to feel that she had not returned to her old residence but had arrived at some unfamiliar place; frightened, she refused for a while to leave the carriage.

units.source_text: 众侍女觉得公主太孩子气了，多方劝请，不胜其烦。

en.t: The waiting women thought the princess was being far too childish, and they grew thoroughly weary as they tried in every way to coax and persuade her.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将暂住在东厅的南厢中，装作一向住惯的模样。

en.t: General Yugiri was temporarily staying in the south wing of the eastern hall, acting as though he had always been accustomed to living there.
